navIcons.note: Unchanged: 24-box round-join craft nav, bbox/overflow gate D/T/M.

typeSystems.note: Unchanged: six display faces, device-aware chrome.

imagery.note: Coat is two panels with a V opening, shoulder shelf, waist suppression, buttons, pockets and cuffs on a dress form — not a capsule. Trousers hang from a hanger with waistband, crease, cuffs and a gap. Dress is a column with bodice; Osso skirt is pleated. Ricciola/gambero/ostrica/tonno are four different platings. Atelier cover is a courtyard well; Olivo is a gnarled trunk with organic canopy; Fienile is a planked barn; contact sheet is 2x2 distinct scenes. Still procedural SVG, not photography.

semanticDiversity.note: 7812483 tickets were off-by-one (Ricciola showed the next dish) and reused one pink-slice composition. Now each look/ticket/plate title matches data-garment/data-dish/data-scene. Canvas hue/luminance fingerprints require pairwise distance so identical compositions fail. Browser gate would fail 7812483.

emptySpaceHierarchy.note: Lookbook featured garment, magazine cover+stack, crudo hero+tickets kept. Titles readable D/T/M, no card overlap.

interaction.note: in prova / data-state=on kept. Hover/pressed/loading/empty/success gates kept D/T/M.

nonTautological: GEOMETRIC_REGRESSIONS rejects 7812483 oval coat c16-28 48-40, tube trousers v210c0 16-8 24, blob gambero c20-28 70-40, blob ostrica M250 210c-20-36
fashion slots 0-3 require four distinct data-garment values (coat/dress/trousers/skirt)
coat requires data-part=shoulder and waist, shoulder getBBox width > 1.08 × waist (fails on a capsule)
trousers require waistband, crease, two data-part=leg with a gap, cuff, hanger
crudo tickets: title Ricciola|Gambero|Ostrica|Tonno must equal data-dish, four unique dishes (fails 7812483 off-by-one)
ticket thumbs D/T: canvas hue/luminance fingerprint pairwise distance >= 48 (fails reused pink slices)
look sils D/T and atelier plates D/T: fingerprint pairwise distance
gambero requires antenna+shell; ostrica requires shell; tonno requires fat-line and deep-red fills
atelier lastre: title Pozzo|Olivo|Fienile must equal data-scene, unique across plates
look/ticket/plate h2 height >= 14 and width >= 48; look cards overlap area < 24px
